spots.name: Minneapolis Sculpture Garden
spots.blurb: Free year-round sculpture park home to Spoonbridge and Cherry, open 6 am to midnight
spots.blurbEs: Parque de esculturas gratis todo el año con Spoonbridge and Cherry, abierto de 6 am a medianoche

spots.name: Minneapolis Institute of Art
spots.blurb: Major art museum with free general admission
spots.blurbEs: Gran museo de arte con entrada general gratis

spots.name: Mill City Museum
spots.blurb: Flour-milling history museum built into the ruins of a riverfront mill
spots.blurbEs: Museo de la historia de la molienda de harina dentro de las ruinas de un molino junto al río

spots.name: Stone Arch Bridge
spots.blurb: Historic pedestrian bridge with views of St. Anthony Falls
spots.blurbEs: Puente peatonal histórico con vistas a las cataratas de St. Anthony

spots.name: Mill Ruins Park
spots.blurb: Riverfront park among the excavated ruins of old flour mills
spots.blurbEs: Parque junto al río entre las ruinas excavadas de antiguos molinos de harina

spots.name: Como Park Zoo & Conservatory
spots.blurb: Free zoo and glass-domed conservatory, open daily 10 am to 4 pm (conservatory closed Mondays)
spots.blurbEs: Zoológico y conservatorio con cúpula de vidrio gratis, abiertos a diario de 10 am a 4 pm (el conservatorio cierra los lunes)
